extracted_information: Webmin是一款基于Web的Unix-like服务器系统管理工具，全球每年安装量约1,000,000次。它可以用于配置操作系统内部组件（如用户、磁盘配额、服务、配置文件）以及管理和控制开源应用（如BIND DNS Server, Apache HTTP Server, PHP, MySQL等）。网站内容还详细列出了Webmin和Usermin的最新版本信息、发布日期、下载文件大小以及各版本的更新内容和修复。

supported_platforms_implied: Systems using .rpm packages (e.g., RHEL, CentOS, Fedora)
technical_characteristics_from_changelog: Support for Forgotten password recovery (built-in and for Virtualmin mailbox users)
Support for SSL certificates and DNS over TLS in BIND module
Support to configure listen for any type of address in Dovecot module
Ability to manage available PHP packages directly from PHP Configuration module
Ability to configure and show proper branding logo on the login page
Display of the PHP binary and its version in the PHP Configuration module
Improvements to MySQL/MariaDB module when editing users and privileges
Support for AxoSyslog in System Logs NG module
TOML as editable format in the File Manager module
Support for template variables in help pages
Support for enabling gender-neutral translations (if supported by language)
Improved security of single-use login links
Check if local version of mysqldump supports --set-gtid-purged flag
Respect option to copy new key and certificate to Webmin in the SSL Encryption module
Use new API for auxiliary remote QR code generation
Show human-readable timestamps for kernel log in the System Logs module
Respect reverse order flag in the System Logs module
Prefer JSON::XS over JSON::PP if available for better performance
Fix bugs with IPv6 interface creation on systems using Network Manager
Address security issue in the System Documentation module
Use fast PRC mode by default in the Webmin Servers Index module
Fail2Ban version detection fixes
Follow German translation rules
Preserve allow/deny IPs in Webmin Configuration module
Enhancements to module config saving reliability
Improve wording when applying network in Network Configuration module
Regression fix in MySQL/MariaDB database user permission assignment
Clean up old code
Fix permissions error when attempting to open a temp file for writing
Network Configuration module uses ip command instead of ifconfig on Debian
Correctly save IPv6 nameservers in Network Configuration module
Run man as nobody to prevent section param misuse in System Documentation module
Support for Sendmail hash files ending with .cdb
Check correctly if ProFTPD is installed
Properly escape HTML in date fields
Fix line height of plain-text email body

features: Web-based system administration for Unix-like servers
Configure operating system internals (users, disk quotas, services, configuration files)
Modify and control open-source applications (BIND, Apache, PHP, MySQL, etc.)
Support for forgotten password recovery (Webmin and Usermin, for Virtualmin mailbox users)
DNS over TLS configuration in BIND module
Configure and display branding logo on login page
TOML format editing in File Manager
Improved security for single-use login links
Security fixes in System Documentation module
Fast PRC mode in Webmin Servers Index module
Fixes for MySQL/MariaDB user permission assignment
Network Configuration module uses ip command (on Debian)
references: API for auxiliary remote QR code generation
